modules.name: Pin
modules.description: Binds one jack to any knob, switch, button or light on another module, in both directions.

modules.name: Marionette
modules.description: Eight channels that each bind a jack to knobs, switches, buttons or lights on other modules, edited from its screen.

modules.name: Troupe
modules.description: Opens a named group of modules, with four macro knobs that drive controls within the group.

modules.name: Wing
modules.description: Closes the group a Troupe opened.

modules.name: Tag
modules.description: Names the module beside it, so paths can reach it as $name.

modules.name: Tether
modules.description: Drives a knob on whatever module its cord is patched to, passing the signal through.

modules.name: Stage
modules.description: A hub of 64 bindings fed by eight jacks or eight macros, edited from a large screen by panel or keyboard.

modules.name: Crew
modules.description: Eight more inputs and readback outputs for the Stage to its left; up to three chain on.

modules.name: Poses
modules.description: Captures a set of controls as 16 poses, recalls them with a glide and crossfades between two, either end muteable.
